verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Corporations Canada publishes fees, channels and processing times up front, such as $200 and 1 day online or a 4-hour express option. Processing turnaround is an adjacent disclosure, though, and nothing in the pack documents operating-hours windows, per-day filing limits or session timeouts for the Online Filing Centre. This disclosure question fairly applies to a government online filing service, so the absence of evidence makes the verdict none.
